glossary.definition: (1) "Tenant" means a person who is entitled under a rental agreement to the use or occupancy of premises, other than premises located in a manufactured home park, to the exclusion of others, except that as used in division (A)(6) of section 1923.02 and section 1923.051 of the Revised Code, "tenant" includes a manufactured home park resident.
glossary.source_title: Section 1923.01 - Jurisdiction in forcible entry and detainer - definitions.

glossary.definition: (2) "Landlord" means the owner, lessor, or sublessor of premises, or the agent or person the landlord authorizes to manage premises or to receive rent from a tenant under a rental agreement, except, if required by the facts of the action to which the term is applied, "landlord" means a park operator.
glossary.source_title: Section 1923.01 - Jurisdiction in forcible entry and detainer - definitions.

glossary.definition: (3) "Resident" has the same meaning as in section 4781.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 1923.01 - Jurisdiction in forcible entry and detainer - definitions.

glossary.definition: (4) "Residential premises" has the same meaning as in section 5321.01 of the Revised Code, except, if required by the facts of the action to which the term is applied, "residential premises" has the same meaning as in section 4781.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 1923.01 - Jurisdiction in forcible entry and detainer - definitions.

glossary.definition: (5) "Rental agreement" means any agreement or lease, written or oral, that establishes or modifies the terms, conditions, rules, or other provisions concerning the use or occupancy of premises by one of the parties to the agreement or lease, except that "rental agreement," as used in division (A)(13) of section 1923.02 of the Revised Code and where the context requires as used in this chapter, means a rental agreement as defined in division (D) of section 5322.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 1923.01 - Jurisdiction in forcible entry and detainer - definitions.

glossary.definition: (6) "Controlled substance" has the same meaning as in section 3719.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 1923.01 - Jurisdiction in forcible entry and detainer - definitions.

glossary.definition:
(7) "School premises" has the same meaning as in section 2925.01 of the Revised Code.

(8) "Sexually oriented offense" and "child-victim oriented offense" have the same meanings as in section 2950.01 of the Revised Code.

(9) "Recreational vehicle" and "mobile home" have the same meanings as in section 4501.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 1923.01 - Jurisdiction in forcible entry and detainer - definitions.

glossary.definition: (10) "Manufactured home" has the same meaning as in section 3781.06 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 1923.01 - Jurisdiction in forcible entry and detainer - definitions.

glossary.definition: (11) "Manufactured home park" has the same meaning as in section 4781.01 of the Revised Code and also means any tract of land upon which one or two manufactured or mobile homes used for habitation are parked, either free of charge or for revenue purposes, pursuant to rental agreements between the owners of the manufactured or mobile homes and the owner of the tract of land.
glossary.source_title: Section 1923.01 - Jurisdiction in forcible entry and detainer - definitions.

glossary.definition: (12) "Park operator" has the same meaning as in section 4781.01 of the Revised Code and also means a landlord of premises upon which one or two manufactured or mobile homes used for habitation are parked, either free of charge or for revenue purposes, pursuant to rental agreements between the owners of the manufactured or mobile homes and a landlord who is not licensed as a manufactured home park operator pursuant to Chapter 4781. of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 1923.01 - Jurisdiction in forcible entry and detainer - definitions.

glossary.definition: (13) "Personal property" means tangible personal property other than a manufactured home, mobile home, or recreational vehicle that is the subject of an action under this chapter.
glossary.source_title: Section 1923.01 - Jurisdiction in forcible entry and detainer - definitions.

glossary.definition: (14) "Preschool or child care center premises" has the same meaning as in section 2950.034 of the Revised Code.
glossary.normalized: preschool or child care center premises
glossary.source_title: Section 1923.01 - Jurisdiction in forcible entry and detainer - definitions.
glossary.term: Preschool or child care center premises

glossary.definition:
(15) "Minor tenant" means a tenant under eighteen years of age who is not emancipated.
